```{r 1_1, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
emalgK <- function(dat, K=3, eps=1e-6, tiny=1e-12, maxit=10000, keep_history=TRUE){
  n <- length(dat)
  pik <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=n, ncol=K)

  # initialization
  p     <- rep(1/K, K)
  s0    <- sd(dat) * 2/3
  sigma <- rep(s0, K)
  m0    <- mean(dat)
  mu    <- seq(m0 - s0, m0 + s0, length.out=K)

  loglik <- function(){
    ll <- 0
    for (j in 1:n){
      s <- 0
      for (k in 1:K){
        s <- s + p[k] * dnorm(dat[j], mean=mu[k], sd=sigma[k])
      }
      ll <- ll + log(max(s, tiny))
    }
    ll
  }

  # history
  if (keep_history){
    phist     <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=maxit, ncol=K)
    muhist    <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=maxit, ncol=K)
    sigmahist <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=maxit, ncol=K)
    llhist    <- rep(NA_real_, maxit)
  }

  ll_old <- -Inf
  it <- 0

  repeat {
    it <- it + 1

    ### E step ###
    for (j in 1:n){
      num <- numeric(K)
      for (k in 1:K){
        num[k] <- p[k] * dnorm(dat[j], mean=mu[k], sd=sigma[k])
      }
      den <- sum(num)
      if (!is.finite(den) || den < tiny) den <- tiny
      for (k in 1:K){
        pik[j,k] <- num[k] / den
      }
    }

    ### M step ###
    Nk <- colSums(pik)
    p <- Nk / n
    p <- pmax(p, tiny); p <- p / sum(p)

    for (k in 1:K){
      mu[k] <- sum(pik[,k] * dat) / Nk[k]
      v <- sum(pik[,k] * (dat - mu[k]) * (dat - mu[k])) / Nk[k]
      sigma[k] <- sqrt(max(v, tiny))
    }

    ll_new <- loglik()

    if (keep_history){
      phist[it,]     <- p
      muhist[it,]    <- mu
      sigmahist[it,] <- sigma
      llhist[it]     <- ll_new
    }

    # stopping: relative logLik improvement
    rel_impr <- (ll_new - ll_old) / max(abs(ll_old), 1)
    if (is.finite(rel_impr) && rel_impr < eps) break
    if (it >= maxit) break
    ll_old <- ll_new
  }

  if (!keep_history){
    return(list(p=p, mu=mu, sigma=sigma, it=it, logLik=ll_new))
  }

  phist     <- phist[1:it,, drop=FALSE]
  muhist    <- muhist[1:it,, drop=FALSE]
  sigmahist <- sigmahist[1:it,, drop=FALSE]
  llhist    <- llhist[1:it]

  list(p=p, mu=mu, sigma=sigma, it=it, logLik=ll_new,
       phist=phist, muhist=muhist, sigmahist=sigmahist, llhist=llhist)
}

load("threepops.Rdata")
length(dat3p)

hist(dat3p, breaks=20, col="grey80", main="Histogram of dat3p", xlab="dat3p")

fit <- emalgK(dat3p, K=3, eps=1e-6)
cat("p:     ", paste(fit$p, collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("mu:    ", paste(fit$mu, collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("sigma: ", paste(fit$sigma, collapse=", "), "\n")

par(mfrow=c(3,1), mar=c(4,4,2,1))

matplot(fit$phist, type="l", lty=1, xlab="Iteration", ylab="p_k")
matplot(fit$muhist, type="l", lty=1, xlab="Iteration", ylab="mu_k")
matplot(fit$sigmahist, type="l", lty=1, xlab="Iteration", ylab="sigma_k")

plot(fit$llhist, type="l", xlab="Iteration", ylab="log-likelihood")
```

```{r 2_1, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Ensure numeric matrix with column names
X <- as.matrix(bankdata)
storage.mode(X) <- "double"

set.seed(1)
n <- nrow(X)
k <- 22
sel <- sample.int(n, k)

## Plot all clients + highlight the selected 22
make_plot <- function (X, sel, title) {
  plot(
    X[, 1], X[, 2],
    pch = 16, cex = 0.5, col = grDevices::adjustcolor("grey30", alpha.f = 0.35),
    xlab = colnames(X)[1], ylab = colnames(X)[2],
    main = title
  )
  points(X[sel, 1], X[sel, 2], pch = 19, cex = 1.2, col = "red")
  points(X[sel, 1], X[sel, 2], pch = 1,  cex = 1.6, col = "black")
  text(X[sel, 1], X[sel, 2], labels = seq_along(sel), pos = 3, cex = 0.7, col = "black")  
}

make_plot(X, sel, sprintf("Bank clients (n=%d) with random starting set (k=%d)", n, k))
cat("crit(starting selection) =", crit(bankdata, sel), "\n")
```

### b

```{r 2_2, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#####
# 2(b)
#####
crit_fast <- function(dat, subs) {
  X <- as.matrix(dat)
  M <- X[subs, , drop = FALSE]          
  x2 <- rowSums(X^2)                    # n
  m2 <- rowSums(M^2)                    # k
  D2 <- outer(x2, m2, "+") - 2 * (X %*% t(M))   # n x k
  sum(sqrt(pmax(D2, 0))[cbind(seq_len(nrow(X)), max.col(-D2))]) # nearest per row
}

# dist_mat <- function(X) {
#   X <- as.matrix(X)
#   x2 <- rowSums(X^2)
#   D2 <- outer(x2, x2, "+") - 2 * (X %*% t(X))
#   sqrt(pmax(D2, 0))
# }

sa_minimize_crit <- function(dat, k = 22,
                             init_subs = NULL,
                             n_iter = 20000,
                             T0 = NULL,
                             cooling = c("geometric", "log"),
                             alpha = 0.999,        # for geometric cooling
                             seed = 1,
                             verbose_every = 1000) {

  cooling <- match.arg(cooling)
  set.seed(seed)

  n <- nrow(dat)
  if (n < k) stop("k must be <= nrow(dat).")
  if (ncol(dat) != 2) stop("dat must have exactly 2 columns (age, balance).")

  # initial subset
  if (is.null(init_subs)) {
    subs <- sample.int(n, k)
  } else {
    subs <- as.integer(init_subs)
    if (length(subs) != k) stop("init_subs must have length k.")
    if (any(subs < 1 | subs > n)) stop("init_subs has out-of-range indices.")
    if (anyDuplicated(subs)) stop("init_subs must contain unique indices.")
  }

  cur_cost <- crit_fast(dat, subs)

  # When T0 is not supplied, we estimate a sensible scale for T0 by:
  # 1) proposing many random 1-for-1 swap moves around the current subset,
  # 2) measuring their cost increase delta (only positive/uphill deltas),
  # 3) setting T0 to the median positive delta (robust "typical uphill move size"),
  # so early iterations accept some uphill moves at a non-negligible rate.
  if (is.null(T0)) {
    trial_deltas <- numeric(200)
    subs_set <- rep(FALSE, n); subs_set[subs] <- TRUE
    for (t in seq_along(trial_deltas)) {
      out <- sample(subs, 1)
      inn <- sample(which(!subs_set), 1)
      cand <- subs
      cand[cand == out] <- inn
      trial_deltas[t] <- crit_fast(dat, cand) - cur_cost
    }
    pos <- trial_deltas[trial_deltas > 0]
    T0 <- if (length(pos)) stats::median(pos) else 1
  }

  # tracking best solution found
  best_subs <- subs
  best_cost <- cur_cost

  # membership vector for fast "in subset?" checks
  in_sub <- rep(FALSE, n); in_sub[subs] <- TRUE

  temp <- T0
  cost_trace   <- numeric(n_iter)
  temp_trace   <- numeric(n_iter)
  accept_trace <- integer(n_iter)  # 1 if accepted, 0 otherwise

  for (it in 1:n_iter) {

    # record temperature used for the decision this iteration
    temp_trace[it] <- temp

    # propose a SWAP: remove one in-sub, add one out-of-sub
    out_id <- sample(subs, 1)
    in_id  <- sample(which(!in_sub), 1)

    cand_subs <- subs
    cand_subs[cand_subs == out_id] <- in_id

    cand_cost <- crit_fast(dat, cand_subs)
    dE <- cand_cost - cur_cost  # >0 means worse (since we minimize)

    accept <- FALSE
    if (dE <= 0) {
      accept <- TRUE
    } else {
      if (stats::runif(1) < exp(-dE / temp)) accept <- TRUE  # Metropolis criterion
    }

    if (accept) {
      accept_trace[it] <- 1L

      subs <- cand_subs
      cur_cost <- cand_cost

      in_sub[out_id] <- FALSE
      in_sub[in_id]  <- TRUE

      if (cur_cost < best_cost) {
        best_cost <- cur_cost
        best_subs <- subs
      }
    }

    # cooling schedule
    if (cooling == "geometric") {
      temp <- temp * alpha
    } else { # logarithmic
      temp <- T0 / log(it + 2)
    }

    cost_trace[it] <- cur_cost

    if (verbose_every > 0 && it %% verbose_every == 0) {
      cat(sprintf("iter %d | T=%.4g | cur=%.6g | best=%.6g | acc_rate=%.3f\n",
                  it, temp_trace[it], cur_cost, best_cost, mean(accept_trace[1:it])))
    }
  }

  list(best_subs = best_subs,
       best_cost = best_cost,
       last_subs = subs,
       last_cost = cur_cost,
       T0 = T0,
       trace = cost_trace,
       temp_trace = temp_trace,
       accept_trace = accept_trace)
}
```

### c

#### Logarithmic cooling 

```{r 2_3, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#####
# 2(c)
#####
res <- sa_minimize_crit(bankdata, k=22, n_iter=30000,
                        cooling="log", T0=NULL, seed=1)
res$best_cost
res$best_subs
make_plot(X, res$best_subs, sprintf("Best candidates for logarithmic cooling schedule. Cost:%.1f", res$best_cost))

w <- 200
acc_roll <- stats::filter(res$accept_trace, rep(1/w, w), sides = 1)
plot(res$temp_trace, acc_roll, type="l",
     xlab="Temperature", ylab="Acceptance rate (rolling, w=200)",
     xlim=rev(range(res$temp_trace, na.rm=TRUE)))

plot(res$temp_trace, type="l", xlab="Iteration", ylab="Temperature")
plot(stats::filter(res$accept_trace, rep(1/200, 200), sides=1),
     type="l", xlab="Iteration", ylab="Acceptance rate (rolling)")
```

#### Too small T0 + fast cooling 

```{r 2_3_1, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
alpha=0.9
T0=100
res <- sa_minimize_crit(bankdata, k=22, n_iter=30000,
                        cooling="geometric", T0=T0, alpha=alpha, seed=1)
res$best_cost
res$best_subs
make_plot(X, res$best_subs, sprintf("Geometric alpha=%.4f, T0=%d. Cost:%.1f", alpha, T0, res$best_cost))

w <- 200
acc_roll <- stats::filter(res$accept_trace, rep(1/w, w), sides = 1)
plot(res$temp_trace, acc_roll, type="l",
     xlab="Temperature", ylab="Acceptance rate (rolling, w=200)",
     xlim=rev(range(res$temp_trace, na.rm=TRUE)))

plot(res$temp_trace, type="l", xlab="Iteration", ylab="Temperature")
plot(stats::filter(res$accept_trace, rep(1/200, 200), sides=1),
     type="l", xlab="Iteration", ylab="Acceptance rate (rolling)")
```
